Ideas for handover notes for people travelling soon
What you should know comes first
Companion Animal Travel Desk routine handover notes

At Aurelia Skyways, the Companion Animal Travel Desk keeps companion animal trips steady, calm, and safe. These notes are for desk handovers, so the next team member can pick up the case without guesswork or delays.

Start with the basics of the trip and the animal's current needs. Include any comfort concerns, feeding guidance, crate checks, or handling preferences that matter for the journey. Keep the wording simple and clear, so the next person can act without having to decode anything.

If a welfare coordinator has reviewed the case, note the main comfort points they raised and anything that still needs attention. That may include space, airflow, bedding, or a quieter route through the airport. The aim is to protect the animal's welfare while keeping the passenger informed in a calm, practical way.

The ground team also needs clean, careful notes when a carrier must move between services. Say where the carrier is, who last checked it, and whether it should be moved gently or left in a quiet area. Good handover notes help crews avoid rushed handling and reduce stress for the animal.

It also helps to mention any updates shared with the passenger, especially if the plan changed or if extra care is needed at the counter or gate. Keep the tone warm and factual. Short notes are fine when they are complete and accurate.

Before you pass the file on, read it once more and make sure nothing important is missing. If you need more help, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk for further guidance.
